data.name: Code 87
data.detailed_description:
Blue Hive City was once home to BHL Corporation, a company celebrated for its revolutionary products. But behind its success, something far more sinister was hidden.

A mysterious virus has consumed the city, mutating its residents into horrifying creatures and giving birth to terrifying unknown entities. With no human survivors left, the corporation's automated security robots continue to patrol the streets, blindly protecting the facility and its darkest secrets.

You and your team are sent into the quarantined city on a critical mission: recover a classified hard drive, locate the antidote, uncover the truth behind the outbreak, and escape alive.

Features :

- Co-op horror adventure first-person shooter game.

- Research : Throughout the game, you must search and find various items, codes, and resources to continue your way.

- Inventory management : You can share your items and weapons with your friends or leave them to manage your inventory.

- Ammo Management: You must use your ammo carefully.

- Revive : You can revive your friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Core i5 or higher
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 580 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: Code 87 contains horror themes, violence, blood, and encounters with hostile humanoid creatures and armed robotic enemies. Players will experience tense situations, combat, and scenes involving death in a dark environment. The game does not contain explicit sexual content, sexual violence, or real-world gambling.
